description: Ministry of Labour - Industrial Dispute between Mr. W. A. S. Wettasinghe vs. The Ceylon Railway uniform staff Benevolent Fund and 2 others and Mr. A. K. P. Mahinda Vs. Sri Lanka Transport Board
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the appointment of arbitrators under the Industrial Disputes Act to settle specific industrial disputes. It references specific legislative enactments (Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon) and exercises powers granted by that legislation. While it mentions the Minister of Labour by name, this is in the context of executing statutory powers rather than detailing his portfolio responsibilities. The core content is about implementing legal/regulatory procedures for dispute resolution under existing labor laws, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
